title: A check not run has not passed
statement: A check that never ran, ran on nothing or was out of service has not passed: count it, and anything made while it was down, as failed or unverified.
example: A per-file test gate reported 0 pass and 0 fail because every file lookup missed.
detail: The reading project's staged item standard counts a blind solve that was not run as a fail, not a pass (`grade3-reading/knowledge_bot/pr-proposals/ti-courseplans-standards/staged/docs/standards/item-quality.md`), and its non-negotiables leave no line blank: absence of evidence is marked unverified, not silence (`grade3-reading/knowledge_bot/pr-proposals/ti-courseplans-standards/staged/docs/standards/non-negotiables.md`). The course-plan standard the project pinned keeps a contribution with no suitable check pending, states the missing check, and forbids agents to invent a passing verdict (`grade3-reading/knowledge_bot/handoffs/g3-reading-v2-feedback-2026-07-16/tooling/ti-courseplans-2169d1f/docs/standards/course-json/README.md`). A per-file test gate once reported 0 pass and 0 fail because every file lookup missed, and the rule since is to treat a 0/0 verdict as a harness bug until proven otherwise (`grade3-reading/knowledge_bot/knowledge/kb-0199-engineering-git-gate-traps.qmd`). Count every empty, invalid, timed-out or unscorable output as failed or unverified too, and make a run over zero items stop with an error.
against: A later run found: the lesson engine's question suggester, with no judge, takes the first well-formed draft unchecked and caches it by text, so the same unchecked question is still served once a judge is back (`g9/transformer/src/question.js`). A later run found counter-evidence (`grade3-reading/ti-courseplans/courses/g4-reading/showcase-lessons/docs/COMPOUNDING-GATE.md`).
